title: Library Management System
summary: A Java library catalog built on a custom hash table, with borrowing, returns and a by-genre view.
problem: Design a data structure around library ISBN numbers that handles the everyday operations of a small library.
approach: Books live in a hash table keyed by ISBN, with chained nodes to handle collisions. A menu-driven program lets a user borrow, return, look up, add and remove books, and lists the whole catalog grouped by genre.
result: All seven menu operations worked against a preloaded sample library. Testing caught a mix-up between int and long types for ISBNs. Next steps would be a real database and a friendlier interface.
